verdict.rationale: GrowthBook is a feature-flag and experimentation platform, not an AI agent or MCP host, so consuming tools from external MCP servers is outside its product role. The evidence shows only that GrowthBook publishes its own official MCP server for AI tools like Cursor and Claude to connect to. That is the server role and cannot be credited toward this client-side story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
